ANNOUNCEMENT:  

I am officially the world’s FIRST transgender woman to become pregnant by 100% natural means.   

Thanks for all your support❤️ https://t.co/Cy9l63Ckxy

description.description: A full-length portrait of a pregnant woman with long brown hair standing on an outdoor stone staircase at dusk. She is wearing a green, gold, and white marbled two-piece outfit consisting of a bandeau top and a long skirt, accented by a decorative body chain over her belly. In the background, there is a scenic view of forested hills and water under a soft twilight sky.
